variants.label: Current smoothing
variants.notes: Current letter distribution plus recent-repeat and vowel/consonant run guards.

variants.label: Current + rare floor
variants.notes: Forces a rare letter after a long rare drought if it can pass smoothing.

variants.label: Current + word nudge
variants.notes: Keeps current randomness but prefers letters that form common bigrams/trigrams with the recent stream.

variants.label: Current + trick floor
variants.notes: Keeps trick letters on pace for at least two full trick-word cycles.

variants.label: 64-letter weighted deck
variants.notes: Draws letters without replacement from a small weighted deck, Tetris-bag style.

variants.label: Deck + rare/trick floors
variants.notes: Combines bagged letters with rare-letter and trick-word reliability floors.

variants.label: Deck + floors + word nudge
variants.notes: Adds a light English bigram/trigram preference to the deck + floor candidate.

variants.label: Deck + floors + vowel ratio guard
variants.notes: Adds a rolling vowel-ratio nudge on top of the deck and floor rules.
